bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be smaller than 14" x 14" at Franklin Music Hall, and backpacks of any size are not allowed. All bags are searched.
prohibited: Professional cameras, GoPros, tripods and selfie sticks
Signs larger than 11" x 17" or on sticks
bagPolicy.note: The venue cannot hold oversized bags. Coat check is offered in every season except summer and is cash only.

parking.note: Parking information is not explicitly detailed on the website. Visitors are advised to check nearby parking facilities or street parking options. Pricing and availability may vary.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Franklin Music Hall's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Small bites and nonalcoholic drinks are sold in the lobby between merchandise and coat check. Alcohol is available in designated 21-and-over areas with valid ID; outside food and beverages are prohibited.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The first floor is fully accessible, with an entrance ramp directly in front of the box office, accessible bathrooms, and an elevated viewing area. Find an event staff member for help entering, or email info@bowerypresents.com with questions. You can also request an ASL interpreter.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: On show days the box office will open 2 hours before the scheduled door time. You may also purchase tickets for all Franklin Music Hall shows with NO SERVICE FEES directly from our box office (421 N 7th Street) on Fridays 12pm-6pm.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Show and door times are listed on the event ticketing page, and doors usually open one hour before the scheduled start time. The entrance next to the box office is accessible.
